title: fix(cli): retire `create`, `lint`, `test` and `studio`, commands that could only fail; correct four residues to what the commands do (objectui#11500)
body:
Fixes #11500

Clause-②: yes

## What

Triage ruled (comment `5960445419`) that four commands of the published `objectui` bin retire, and that four noted residues ride in the same PR as one-line corrections, each to what the command does. This PR:

- removes `create`, `lint`, `test` and `studio` from `packages/cli/src/cli.ts`, and deletes `commands/create-plugin.ts`, `commands/lint.ts`, `commands/test.ts` and `commands/studio.ts`. `plugin` was the only type `create` accepted, so `create` goes whole. Nothing else imported the four modules, and they read nothing under `utils/`, so no other code goes. `SCAFFOLD_DEV_DEPENDENCIES` names neither ESLint nor Vitest, so it is untouched;
- corrects the four residues (`doctor`, `serve` in the docs, `analyze` without `dist/`, `init` with an unknown template);
- drops the four commands' sections from `content/docs/utilities/cli.mdx` and `packages/cli/README.md`, and names the plugin initializer in `cli.mdx`;
- adds the pins in `packages/cli/src/__tests__/cli-bin.test.ts`, all run through the built `dist/cli.js`;
- adds `.changeset/11500-retire-cli-create-lint-test-studio.md` (`@object-ui/cli` `minor`, BREAKING banner, one FROM to TO line per retired command, one line per residue, a Clause-② line).

No refusal code was needed. On the BASE build, commander already refuses any command the program does not declare: `objectui bogus` exits 1 with `error: unknown command 'bogus'`.

## Measured: BASE `fcdc8ec91` build against the HEAD build

One run per row, each in a fresh temp directory, on the built bin. Placeholders are spelled in capitals, because GitHub strips angle-bracket shapes from a saved body.

| Run | BASE | HEAD |
|---|---|---|
| `create plugin x` | exit 1, `Cannot find module` on `create-plugin/dist/index.js` at the worktree ROOT (one directory too high); nothing written | exit 1, `error: unknown command 'create'`; nothing written |
| `lint` | exit 1, "No Object UI application found" | exit 1, `error: unknown command 'lint'` |
| `test` | exit 1, the same precondition error | exit 1, `error: unknown command 'test'` |
| `studio` | run from a temp dir, it found this checkout's `apps/console` through its own `dist` path and started that app's Vite dev server; `timeout` stopped it and nothing was left running | exit 1, `error: unknown command 'studio'` |
| `analyze`, no `dist/` | a warning, then "Analysis complete", exit 0 | `Error: No dist/ directory to analyze. Run objectui build first.` on stderr, exit 1 |
| `init app -t nope` | exit 1, `Unknown template: nope`, and an empty `app/` left behind | exit 1, the same error, nothing written |
| `doctor --help` | "Diagnose and fix common issues". `doctor` writes nothing and prints no Node line | "Diagnose common project setup issues (reports only, changes nothing)" |

## The plugin initializer, measured before it was written

`packages/create-plugin/package.json` names `@object-ui/create-plugin` with one bin, `create-plugin`. It is not `private`, it is in the release's `fixed` group, and npm answers `17.6.0` for it. The bin takes `[plugin-name]`, `-d, --description` and `-a, --author`. In a temp directory, `npm create @object-ui/plugin probe-widget` installed `@object-ui/create-plugin@17.6.0` and ran `create-plugin probe-widget`. Under a pseudo-terminal, taking each prompt's default, it wrote `packages/plugin-probe-widget/` (8 files) and exited 0. So `cli.mdx` now carries a short "Scaffolding a plugin" section with `npm create @object-ui/plugin my-awesome-widget` and a link to the Create Plugin page, which says where to run it. No dependency was added.

## Contract notes

- **The accept set narrows (Clause-② yes).** The published `objectui` bin refuses what it used to accept:
  - FROM `objectui create plugin NAME` (exit 1, generator not found) TO exit 1 with `error: unknown command 'create'`, nothing written. The replacement is `npm create @object-ui/plugin NAME`.
  - FROM `objectui lint` and `objectui test` (exit 1 on every run, a setup error reported as findings) TO the unknown-command error. The replacement is the project's own ESLint and Vitest.
  - FROM `objectui studio` TO the unknown-command error. There is no published replacement; contributors run `pnpm --filter console dev` in the monorepo.
  - FROM `objectui analyze` with no `dist/` exiting 0 TO exiting 1.

  There is no alias, no deprecation window and no silent accept.
- **Unchanged.** `init` with a known template writes the same file map (pinned byte for byte by "writes exactly the file map buildInitFiles returns, byte for byte"). `analyze` over a `dist/` prints the same report. `doctor`'s checks and output are untouched; only its help line moves. No exported symbol of `@object-ui/cli` moves: `src/index.ts` exports `serve` and `init`, and `init`'s signature is unchanged.
- **`validate` and `check` are not edited.** Draft PR objectui#11069 owns them. In the README, only `studio` and `create plugin NAME` leave the heading that also names `check`, `doctor` and `analyze`. Four untouched lines separate that hunk from objectui#11069's `validate` hunk. In `cli.mdx`, no hunk touches the `validate` or `check` sections.
- **Two edits beyond the sections**, both naming retired commands: the README tagline and the `cli.mdx` intro sentence each listed lint and test. Both now say scaffold, develop, build and validate, as the package's own `description` already does.

## Pins

All in `cli-bin.test.ts`, run through the built `dist/cli.js`:

1. The objectui#11496 enumeration pin, "lists exactly the declared commands, no more and no fewer": `SUBCOMMANDS` loses `create`, `lint`, `test` and `studio`.
2. "the retired create, lint, test and studio commands are refused (objectui#11500)": four rows. Each one exits non-zero, its stderr contains `unknown command 'NAME'`, and the temp directory stays empty. The control is `g page Probe` in the same directory, which writes `pages/probe.json`. These runs empty `PATH`. Run from inside a checkout, the BASE `studio` started the console dev server. With no `PATH`, a retired command that came back fails at its first external tool (at BASE, `/bin/sh: 1: pnpm: not found`), and the stderr assertion still turns red.
3. "doctor --help does not claim to fix anything (objectui#11500)": it asserts the kind of claim, not the wording, as the existing `check --help` pin does.
4. "exits non-zero without dist/, and claims no analysis (objectui#11500)".
5. "refuses an unknown template before creating the directory (objectui#11500)". The control is `init probe-app -t simple` in the same directory, which writes `probe-app/app.json`.
6. The `serve` row of the flag-contract table gains `--no-open`, a docs-alignment pin that is green at BASE by design. The `lint` and `test` rows go.

## Reverse verification

Predictions were written down before each leg. In each leg, the mutation is a `git checkout COMMIT -- PATH`, proven on disk by blob hash. The CLI is then rebuilt, a marker is read from `dist/`, and `cli-bin.test.ts` runs. An EXIT/INT/TERM trap restores from HEAD and proves the restore by blob hash, an empty `git diff HEAD` and an empty porcelain.

- **BASE leg.** `cli.ts`, `analyze.ts`, `init.ts` and the four deleted modules at `fcdc8ec91`, with the pins at HEAD `a20223743`. Blobs on disk equalled BASE: `004165f17300`, `63659c0b30c9`, `ad7bde24bfcc`, `e8438188bbc5`, `613605f90d07`, `48db26298d9a`, `5039e918e38e`. `dist/` carried the studio marker and the old doctor text, twice each. Predicted 8 red. Observed `Tests  8 failed | 40 passed (48)`: the enumeration pin, the four refusals, doctor, analyze and init. The `serve` row stayed green, as predicted.
- **Restore-one leg.** HEAD plus `studio` alone: its module from BASE, and its import and command block re-inserted into `cli.ts`, each counted once on disk. Predicted 2 red. Observed `Tests  2 failed | 46 passed (48)`: the enumeration pin and the `studio` refusal. The six other new pins read green here, which also shows `dist/` was rebuilt from this leg's sources.
- **Restore.** The tree equals HEAD `a20223743` (blobs `ec9d879fdc20`, `fb81635c05cb`, `ab62a52b5efd`; the four modules absent), and the CLI was rebuilt. The four BASE markers count 0 in `dist/`, and HEAD's doctor text counts 2, as a positive control.

## Local gates, at HEAD `a20223743`

- `pnpm exec vitest run` over `packages/cli/src/__tests__/` in full, plus every test that names a retired command, `create-plugin`, `cli.mdx` or the CLI README, plus the `scripts/__tests__` readers of the CLI tree: `Test Files  39 passed (39)`, `Tests  658 passed (658)`. The 14 files beyond the CLI suite: `toc-anchor-parity.test.tsx`, `nested-page-children-11223.test.ts`, both `create-plugin` suites, and `spawned-build-vitest-env-8598`, `check-doc-snippet-emitted-census`, `doc-version-claims`, `package-files-exist`, `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273`, `check-published-tsconfig-tooling-exclude`, `body-dialect-census`, `body-dialect-producer-scan` and `check-test-path-roots`. Four other `scripts/__tests__` hits on the names `lint` and `test` are file stems and workflow job names, not the CLI.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli type-check` exit 0 (its `tsconfig` includes `src/**/*`, and `--listFiles` lists `cli-bin.test.ts`); `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli build` exit 0.
- `docs:check-links` "Links are valid across 17 scan roots." · `check:doc-fences` OK · `check:readme-exports` OK · `markdown-test-inputs.mjs --audit` "115 candidate test files, all adjudicated" · `check:control-bytes` OK · `check:new-line-citations` "0 new citation(s)" · `check-changeset-presence.mjs` "8 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)" · `changeset:check` "No changeset declares a `major` bump." · `check:changeset-claims` report-only, see Acceptance notes · `check:pending-changeset-literals` "No test source names a pending changeset." · `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unused-deps`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:unreferenced-sources` and `check:vi-mock-specifiers` OK · `check:doc-snippets` "Every covered documentation snippet compiles against the built types." · `check:doc-examples` OK · `pnpm check` "287 validated … 0 did not validate". The README and snippet gates ran after a scoped build of their package closure; before it they answered PRECONDITION NOT MET, which is not a verdict.
- ESLint over all of `packages/cli/src`, the population CI's `eslint src` lints for this package: 47 files in the JSON output, equal to the 47 tracked `.ts` files there. 0 errors. 5 warnings, all in three files this diff does not touch. Type-aware linting is off (`tseslint.configs.recommended`, no `projectService`), and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads the disk, so the verdicts of untouched files cannot move.
- `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` over the 11 paths: NOT GOVERNED.

The full `pnpm test` and the repo-wide lint are left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **Governed rows this PR leaves to the `skills` lane.** `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md`'s CLI table still lists the retired commands. These rows are cited by content, because a line address in a body is the banned cross-file form:
  - the row reading `objectui studio` / "Visual UI editor"; carrier: seat → objectui#11503
  - the row reading `objectui lint` / "Lint generated app code (ESLint)"; carrier: seat → objectui#11503
  - the row reading `objectui test` / "Run app tests (Vitest)"; carrier: seat → objectui#11503
  - the row reading `objectui create plugin` / "Scaffold a new plugin"; carrier: seat → objectui#11503
- **Residue sizes.** `analyze`: two lines become one `throw`. `doctor`: one help line in `cli.ts` and one sentence in `cli.mdx`. `serve`: one docs line. `init`: one statement hoisted, which is one line added (`const files = buildInitFiles(…)` above the `mkdirSync`) and the loop header collapsed from three lines to one, plus a corrected comment. The old comment's "Unknown templates still throw here, before the first write" was false, because the directory was created first.
- **What `analyze` prints without `dist/`.** Its two header lines still print on stdout before the error. The error is on stderr, and "Analysis complete" no longer prints.
- **`check:changeset-claims`** flagged two pending changesets naming files this PR touches. Both were re-read, and both stay true. `7658-toc-code-span-anchor-parity.md` describes, in the past tense, headings its own change fixed. `7694-chart-series-chart-type-alias-refusal.md` names `objectui validate` in `cli.ts`, which this PR does not touch.
- **Observed, not filed** (no declared contract is violated; carrier: none):
  - `doctor` exits 0 even with an error-level finding. At BASE, in an empty directory, it printed `x package.json not found` and `Found 2 issue(s).`, and exited 0. Nothing documents its exit code.
  - The published `@object-ui/create-plugin@17.6.0`, run with a non-TTY stdin, prints its second prompt and exits 0 with nothing written. objectui#8786's fix is on `main` but unreleased: the published bin contains no `isTTY` check. It ships with the next release.
  - `packages/plugin-markdown/src/toc-anchor-parity.test.tsx`'s `LIVE_SHAPES` still names the `objectui add COMPONENT` heading as live, with `where` naming `cli.mdx` and the README. Since objectui#11496 that heading exists in neither file, and after this PR neither does `objectui create plugin NAME`. The test hard-codes the heading strings and reads no file, so it stays green; only its `where` is stale.
